title: HeadExport
description: The private full export of HEAD for one map version (docs/head-export-format.md): every row of every HEAD table, anchors and private columns included, in the diff format's row format with its id and rev. Rollback restores HEAD from it. Private: stored in the exports bucket, never public. Checked by the writer, not by this schema: each table's entries are sorted by id, ids are unique, and the coordinate rules of map/defs.schema.json.

version.description: The map version the export belongs to (map_versions.id).

published_at.description: When the version was published (map_versions.published_at), in Singapore time.

snapshot_sha256.description: The version's public files (map_versions.snapshot_sha256), for cross-checking.

venues.description: Every row of venues, sorted by id. At most 1000000.

levels.description: Every row of levels, sorted by id. At most 1000000.

spaces.description: Every row of spaces, sorted by id. At most 1000000.

nodes.description: Every row of nodes, sorted by id. At most 1000000.

edges.description: Every row of edges, sorted by id. At most 1000000.

pois.description: Every row of pois, sorted by id. At most 1000000.

anchors.description: Every row of anchors, sorted by id. At most 1000000.

venue.title: HeadVenue
venue.description: One row of venues in HEAD, with its id and rev.

rev.description: venues.rev: bumped by each approved change that touched the row.

permission.description: venues.permission: the reference to the written permission to scan, or null. Written only by the seed script; no diff carries it.

row.description: The row's columns in the diff format (docs/diff-format.md).
